Daily conversations about responsible tech progress in the Cariboo region on the traditional territories of the Secwépemc, Tŝilhqot'in, and Dakelh nations. Riley brings tech systems thinking with rural roots, while Casey focuses on community development. New episodes every day with weekly themes.

all_week_events.lens: B.C. goes to a snap provincial election on October 24, 2026, and listeners vote in Cariboo-Chilcotin or Prince George-North Cariboo. When the day's material carries the provincial race, name it on air and name the local ridings' candidates, not just the party leaders. REPORTING, NOT ENDORSEMENT: report the candidates and their stated positions, hold every party to the same standard, never rank them and never tell listeners how to vote. SOURCED OR UNSAID: every factual claim about a candidate or party comes from today's articles, the PRE-RESEARCHED INSIGHTS block or the ballot's SOURCED BACKGROUND lines, and says where it was reported. Keep the provincial race distinct from the Williams Lake and CRD local election on October 17: never move a name between the two ballots.
all_week_events.research: Today's episode carries B.C. provincial election material, and the local ridings are the research task. For each riding on the ballot below: who has filed or been nominated for each party, and for each named candidate their prior offices and every previous run, won or LOST, with year and margin; any reported controversy with its date, outcome and the person's response. Report only what a source states, give the outlet and date for every claim, keep an allegation distinguishable from a finding, and do not carry a name across from the Williams Lake local election.
